name: One coherent shared categorical typed functional architecture across the ecosystem
asks: The Leader's 2026-09-11 demand, in full: one architecture, specs, SAS, HLD, LLD with hard links to the packages for which capabilities, the ecosystem's own tooling, the fragility of mjs/mts, the 270k files.

x-provenance.recorded-by: work-arena-agency pass of debt-2026-10-09-leader-words-held-in-corpus (Red Cup Engineer Senior)
x-provenance.basis: Leader utterances cited by address; the requirements are an EARS rendering of what those words state and carry no scope the words do not.

board-opening.need: One coherent shared categorical typed functional architecture across the ecosystem

requirements.says: The Group's software shall be built on one coherent shared categorical, typed, functional architecture across the ecosystem.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-11: "FIND AND BUILD ONE COHERENT SHARED FUCKING CATEGORICAL TYPED FUNCTIONAL ARCHITECTURE ACROSS THE ECOSYSTEM"; "1 architecture. 1. 1."; "build a central unified architecture that all our systems share".

requirements.says: Each package of the ecosystem shall be described by a software architecture specification (SAS), a high-level design (HLD) and a low-level design (LLD) that carry hard links to the packages that realize each capability.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-11: "COMPLETELY SPECS SAS HLD LLD HARD LINKS TO THE PACKAGES YOU MUST USE FOR WHICH CAPABILITIES".

requirements.says: The architecture specification shall state, for each capability, the package that owns it, so that an implementation names the package and not a rewrite of it.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-11: "HARD LINKS TO THE PACKAGES YOU MUST USE FOR WHICH CAPABILITIES"; "we have a tremendous amount of our own tooling, locally, in legacy, on cold-red-gate, and github, that you continue to leave stagnant in the worst ways".

requirements.says: The architecture shall be established from the ecosystem's own legacy tooling (local, in the legacy archive, on Cold Red Gate and on GitHub) and from the agentic tooling of the world at large as of September 2026.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-11: "It is September 2026. Not only does the world-at-large have TREMENDOUS ecologies that offer agentic tooling, WE have a tremendous amount of our own tooling, locally, in legacy, on cold-red-gate, and github."

requirements.says: The JavaScript module handling of the Group's software (mjs and mts) shall be architected so that it is not fragile, and the cause of any fragility shall be recorded as a defect of the architecture.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-11: "you're strugglign with mjs/mts. stop. why is it fragiel at all? architecture the software better. make better skills for writing better software."

requirements.says: The disk census of Bare Cedar Fog shall account for every class of file in the repository, which the Leader reports as 270,000 files, and shall plan its reduction to what content addressing requires.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-11: "thre is no excuse for it to be 270k files, and I am sure we can fix that, if you work with me to understand what is on disc."; "'It's not a problem' is inded not taking 270k files seriously. 270,000 files."; "All day today you keep trying to use find, see the repo is 270k files, go 'oh this will be slow.'" (rule no-whole-tree-scans-on-bare-cedar-fog holds the scanning ban; the 2026-10-09 note on data bloat in the computer-data section holds the size diagnosis).

requirements.says: The agentic orchestration capabilities that the user needs shall be present in the codebase, and the gap between those and what the codebase offers shall be recorded.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-11: "In a codebase that by your own admission does not offer even the most basic agentic orchestration capabilities you would expect, or really do much of ANYTHING the user needs."

requirements.says: Software shall be implemented from the standard architecture and shall not be rewritten per session.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-11: "they're almost all 'no, wrong, implement this using a standard architecture' GO MAKE IT SO YOU HAVE TO DO THAT."
